overview_description: List the stock changes recorded for every item and warehouse, and read one inventory adjustment by its id.
intro: An inventory adjustment records one change to an item's stock in a warehouse, such as stock added through the item's inventory endpoints. These endpoints list adjustments across all items and read one by its `id`. This area has 2 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
notes: **Quantities are strings.** `adjustment_amount` and every `quantity_*` field arrive as text, so convert them before doing arithmetic.
**Adjustments are read only.** Adding stock to an item through `POST /items/{item_id}/inventory/add` creates an adjustment, which these endpoints then return.
**One adjustment comes back under `inventory_adjustment`.** The listing puts its records under `data`.
**The listing pages by cursor.** Pass `limit`, then send the `next_cursor` from `pagination` as `cursor` until `has_more` is `false`.

endpoints.title: List inventory adjustments
endpoints.summary: Returns a page of inventory adjustments across all items.
endpoints.description: Returns adjustments under `data`, each naming the item, the warehouse, the `adjustment_amount` and the quantities after the change. Set the page size with `limit` and fetch the next page with `cursor`. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` from the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` to sort descending, as in `-created_on`.

200.description: A page of inventory adjustments, under `data`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an inventory adjustment
endpoints.summary: Returns one inventory adjustment by its `id`.
endpoints.description: Returns the adjustment under `inventory_adjustment`, with the item, the warehouse, the `adjustment_amount` and the quantities after the change, each quantity as a string.

adjustment_amount.description: The change in stock, as a string.

quantity_on_hand.description: The stock on hand after the change, as a string.

limit.description: The page size the API applied.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Trust it over `next_cursor`, which can be stale on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page.
